description: The pelvis forms a sturdy bowl that transfers weight from spine to legs while opening dramatic planes for figure drawing.

landmarks.name: Iliac crest
landmarks.desc: Broad ridge sweeping from ASIS to PSIS, a key landmark for hip rhythms.

landmarks.name: Anterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.desc: Forward point that sets the waist triangle and anchors sartorius origins.

landmarks.name: Posterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.desc: Dimpled rear marker where the sacrum meets the ilium in gentle pits.

landmarks.name: Pubic symphysis
landmarks.desc: Midline joint tying left and right pubic bodies, guiding the groin wedge.

landmarks.name: Ischial tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Sitting bone that bears weight when seated and anchors hamstring tendons.

landmarks.name: Acetabulum
landmarks.desc: Socket that receives the femoral head and defines the hip's spherical pivot.
